subject: English
question_text: Fill in the gaps with suitable prepositions, articles and zero articles (a, an, the or x): 0.
stimulus: The development of a nation is not (a) _____ easy task. It depends (b) _____ the willingness and sacrificing attitude of the valliant sons and daughters of (c) _____ soil. They don't work for any appreciation or reward for (d) _____ themselves. Their vision is to make (e) _____ world a better place to live (f) _____. They are always proud (g) _____ undertaking selfless ventures. Their mission is to serve (h) _____ greater interest of humanity. They spend their lives for the welfare of people, the society and the country as (i) _____ whole. People (j) _____ such vision and mission help uphold the dignity of a nation.
guide_solution: (a) an (b) on (c) the (d) × (e) the (f) in (g) of (h) the (i) a (j) with
